cohort: The cohort consisted of 6,781 Japanese women with a Body Mass Index (BMI) >=25 kg/m2 who had singleton pregnancies and were registered in the Japan Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology system in 2013.
finding: The optimal gestational weight gain was found to be 0 to 11.5 kg for overweight pregnant Japanese women and weight loss for obese pregnant Japanese women.
